summary: The foreign private issuer reported the resignation of Vice Chairman Gonzalo Guerrero Yamamoto and the appointment of Hernán Büchi Buc as replacement via a Form 6-K. No shareholder vote, takeover premium, or deal consideration is involved. The change appears orderly and board-initiated, not abrupt. As an Argentine/Chilean filer, this maps to a US current report on Form 8-K Item 5.02. What to watch: any subsequent departures or strategic shifts signaling deeper governance friction.
